_about: Frozen self-identification lexicon for the TPG organizational strand. This file is the single authoritative copy. It is attached to the OSF registration and read at runtime by lexicon_proxy.py; the Codebook sheet of the protocol workbook records the same terms for coders.
_rules: Every term derives from the manuscript's own taxonomy section, so the instrument operationalizes the argument rather than importing vocabulary the study does not engage.

This list is FROZEN. Do not add terms during collection. A term surfaced during the review that is absent from this list is a FINDING, recorded in nonlexicon_self_description and reported as a result.
Patterns are surface variants counted as the same canonical term. They absorb spelling and spacing differences only, and never broaden the concept.
Matching is case-insensitive. A match is a SAMPLING AID only: it is not the tier assignment, which requires the placement of the phrase and the identity of the speaker.
